name: Beirut
notes: Reuses settings.GBA_CENTER_LATLON directly -- skip geocoding for this node. Aggregates the already-modeled B1-B7/ML1-4 trunk network from Layer B.

name: Tripoli
notes: ML4's real geocoded terminus in this repo. NOTE: ocftc_digitized/README.md's original source search only confirmed B1/B2/B3/ML3 as regularly operating -- ML4's operating status is unconfirmed, not just planned-vs-built.

name: Jounieh
notes: Intermediate point on the real ML4 corridor. Cedar Waves ferry port (Jounieh-Cyprus service), launch reported for mid-2026.

name: Saida
notes: Intermediate point on the real B6-ML2 corridor.

name: Tyre
notes: B6-ML2's real geocoded terminus in this repo (confirmed via ocftc_stops_manual.csv, last stop = 'Tyre / Borj El Chmali Intersection'). Operating status unconfirmed, same caveat as Tripoli.

name: Chtaura
notes: ML1's real geocoded terminus in this repo. Operating status unconfirmed, same caveat as Tripoli.

name: Baalbek
notes: Beyond ML1's actual terminus (Chtaura) -- no formal transit reaches Baalbek today.

name: Rayak
notes: Historic junction of the narrow-gauge Beirut-Damascus line and the standard-gauge line toward Homs/Aleppo/the old Hejaz network. Dormant since the network shut down in the 1970s-1990s.

name: Masnaa
notes: Lebanon-Syria crossing on the historic/current Beirut-Damascus corridor.

name: Aboudiyeh
notes: Lebanon-Syria crossing on the historic Tripoli-Homs rail corridor; also the corridor named in 2024-2025 Lebanese rail-revival feasibility discussions.

name: Damascus
notes: Historic Beirut-Damascus rail terminus; Arab Mashreq International Railway node.

name: Homs
notes: Historic Tripoli-Homs rail terminus; node on the Hejaz Railway revival corridor.

name: Aleppo
notes: Stands in for the Turkey-bound leg of the Hejaz Railway revival (the Sept 2025 Turkey-Syria-Jordan framework's first phase: Turkey to Aleppo, then Aleppo-Damascus-Jordan).

name: Amman
notes: Node for the April 2026 Amman trilateral transport memorandum (Turkey-Syria-Jordan).

name: Riyadh
notes: Node for the June 2026 Turkey-Saudi Arabia MoU extending the revival from Jordan's al-Haditha crossing into the Saudi network.

name: Larnaca
notes: Cedar Waves ferry destination from Jounieh (~4hr crossing), launch reported for mid-2026.

name: Latakia
notes: Cedar Waves planned extension from Jounieh.

name: Mersin
notes: Cedar Waves planned extension from Jounieh.
